title: HR Executive
description: Manage recruitment, candidate screening, interviews, and employee onboarding. Maintain employee records, attendance, and payroll data while coordinating HR documentation, employee queries, performance reviews, and exit formalities.

title: Relationship Manager
description: Manage customer relationships, understand property requirements, recommend suitable properties, and coordinate property visits. Follow up with prospects, maintain CRM records, resolve customer queries, and achieve assigned sales targets.

title: Business Development Manager
description: Identify new business opportunities, develop revenue growth strategies, build partnerships, and manage the sales pipeline to drive successful closures. Guide BDEs and Relationship Managers, monitor team performance, analyse market trends, prepare sales reports and forecasts, and achieve assigned business and revenue targets.

title: Business Development Executive
description: Generate leads through property portals, online platforms, referrals, and other sources, and contact prospective property owners, tenants, buyers, and sellers. Qualify leads, introduce company services, follow up with prospects, coordinate property visits, update lead records, support closures, and achieve assigned lead generation and sales targets.
